pickWhiteTip: Pick something that should be grey or white
pickWhite: Click something that should be grey or white · Esc to stop
pickWindow: Click the color this window takes · Esc to stop
pickWindowTip: Pick its color on the picture
curveHelp: Click the line to add a point, drag it, double-click to take it away. Luma moves red, green and blue alike.

hslHelp.hueHue: Turns one hue toward another: lift a point over a hue to shift it.
hslHelp.hueSat: More or less color in one hue: the sky bluer, the grass calmer.
hslHelp.hueLum: One hue brighter or darker, in stops.
hslHelp.lumSat: Saturation by brightness: calm the color in deep shadows or bright highlights.
hslHelp.satSat: Saturation by saturation: lift dull colors without pushing loud ones.

windowsHelp: A window changes one range of colors only: a face, a sky, a dress. Pick its color on the picture, then check its matte.
inputHelp: How the clip was recorded. Camera log footage looks flat and pale until its log is chosen here.

outputHelp.auto: Video stays as it came; log and HDR roll off their highlights as film does.
outputHelp.film: Highlights roll off softly, as film does.
outputHelp.standard: What goes past white is clipped.

lookHelp: A LUT of yours on top of the grade, mixed in by an amount.
autoTip: White balance from what is nearly grey, exposure to a usual middle
resetTip: Take the grade off (log keeps its conversion)
noClips: The film has no video clips to grade yet.
lutMissing: {path} could not be read: shown without it
